# Growth Model Kit

> Simple calculators to support product growth decisions with numbers, by Dmitrii Pankov. The tools are parts of one model: Activation, Engagement and Virality feed retention, revenue per active user and new users per month; MAU and LTV turn them into users and money. Retention is the base of the model.

The retention curve: a cohort starts at 100% in the month it joins, falls fast at first, then flattens. Retention is the share still active in the month it flattens (the plateau); churn is the share of them who leave each month after that.

## Tools

- [MAU](https://growthmodelkit.com/model/mau/): where monthly active users and revenue go, and which lever moves them most. MAU moves toward a ceiling where new users only replace the ones who leave: MAU ceiling = new users per month × average lifetime of a user.
- [LTV](https://growthmodelkit.com/model/ltv/): what one new user is worth. LTV = monthly revenue per active user × average lifetime. Average lifetime is the sum of the retention curve over all months; after the plateau it adds retention / churn.
- [Activation](https://growthmodelkit.com/model/activation/): how better onboarding lifts retention. Retention of all new users = share who activate × their retention + share of the others × theirs.
- [Engagement](https://growthmodelkit.com/model/engagement/): how engagement lifts revenue per active user. Revenue per active user = sum over casual, core and power users of their share × their revenue per user.
- [Virality](https://growthmodelkit.com/model/virality/): how many users a new one brings. K-factor = invites per user × share of invites that turn into users. Growth multiplier after n viral cycles = 1 + k + k² + … + kⁿ; with k below 1 it stops at 1 / (1 − k).

## More

- [The model](https://growthmodelkit.com/model/): how the five tools fit together.
- [About](https://growthmodelkit.com/about/): Dmitrii Pankov, product growth modeling. Builds growth models on real product data.
